collections.title: Abstract
collections.introduction: Abstract brings together fifty numbered works, an origin titled #0000 and a proof-of-stake work titled #pos. The collector’s earlier gallery dates the collection to March 30–April 4, 2022. Three AI-curated exhibitions compare lines, color divisions and the spaces around groups of marks. The recovered works are shown from their published JPEGs.

galleries.title: Marks Crossing Fields
galleries.question: What can a line connect when the surface underneath keeps changing?
galleries.introduction: These eighteen works follow thin lines, bars, dots and loops across very different grounds. Begin with marks held inside a frame, then compare circular routes, open crossings and denser scaffolds. The sequence is an AI visual arrangement; it does not describe the order in which the works were made.
galleries.closing: Look back at one thin line and one broad bar. Which helped you find a route through the image, and where did that route become uncertain?

chapters.title: Frames and directions
chapters.introduction: Start with rectangular boundaries and compare the routes inside them. Rounded loops, a dark lattice and straight diagonals each offer a different way to cross a field.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #01
stops.whyHere: Yellow loops sit inside several uneven rectangular outlines on an orange ground. A green circular form occupies the center while finer lines cross it. The boxes offer a boundary, but the rounded marks refuse to follow their corners.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #03
stops.whyHere: Closely spaced colored lines form a dark lattice across the image. Broad yellow, pink and pale marks interrupt it at the edges and lower center. Compare the thin continuous crossings with these larger shapes that cover several lines at once.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow loops enclosed by irregular boxes give way to a field of closely spaced straight crossings.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #04
stops.whyHere: Cyan, yellow, green and pink diagonals cut across a field of horizontal bands. Broad patches at the edges interrupt both systems. The straight lines supply clear directions, but their crossings make several competing routes through the image.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The lattice continues, but bright diagonals now supply strong competing directions across it.

chapters.title: Circles and repeated marks
chapters.introduction: Circular marks can scatter or gather. Compare isolated dots with coils that retain their outlines, then follow pale hatching as it turns across a darker field.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #05
stops.whyHere: Black dots and rings scatter across smaller bright circles, while broad white marks bridge the middle. Different sizes of circular marks bring some areas forward and leave others behind. The pale bars make a horizontal route through an otherwise dispersed field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The straight diagonals give way to scattered dots and rings crossed by broad white marks.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #36
stops.whyHere: Coils and looping lines cover a dense field of bright colored marks. Some loops retain clear circular boundaries; others disappear among crossing lines. Their different degrees of visibility make recognition possible in one area and uncertain in the next.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Separate dots become looping coils whose edges repeatedly merge into the dense field.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #08
stops.whyHere: White hatch-like marks curve diagonally across a red and purple field. Fine cyan and yellow loops occupy the spaces around them. The repeated pale strokes form a broad route, while the thinner lines offer smaller turns within it.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The coils give way to a broad curved route built from repeated white hatch-like marks.

chapters.title: Fine lines over broad fields
chapters.introduction: Here thin lines remain distinct from the larger color divisions. Follow a loop or upright across an edge, then notice where a broader patch interrupts its continuity.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #18
stops.whyHere: Yellow and red thin lines cross a muted teal field interrupted by dark and purple textures. White marks gather near the lower left and right edge. The fine lines connect areas that the broader textures keep apart.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Fine red and yellow lines remain, while the broad white route breaks into separate patches on teal.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #25
stops.whyHere: Fine black and white looping lines cross soft pink, yellow and muted green planes. Broad yellow and dark bars sit among them. The thin lines retain their own routes even where the color fields beneath them overlap.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The teal surround gives way to softer pink and yellow planes crossed by black and white loops.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #34
stops.whyHere: Short yellow bars and thin white loops cross layered blue, red and green areas. Several darker uprights divide the image. The smaller bright marks seem to connect neighboring zones without removing their separate color boundaries.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: White loops meet short yellow bars, making repeated intervals alongside the continuous fine lines.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #22
stops.whyHere: Bright yellow uprights and short white bars stand against dark green, purple and turquoise areas. Several narrow lines connect the separate bars. The arrangement has a loose scaffold, though its colored marks repeatedly cross beyond that structure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow marks lengthen into uprights and begin to form a loose scaffold.

chapters.title: Lines against darkness
chapters.introduction: A dark ground can make a narrow line unusually clear. Compare the pale descending tangle with tall outlined shapes, then turn toward long crossings on a lighter field.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #19
stops.whyHere: White tangled lines descend across a dark field beside bright yellow and pink patches. Thinner green and red lines take other routes around them. The pale tangle remains distinct because the surrounding darkness leaves its turns easy to follow.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow scaffold gives way to a white descending tangle surrounded by dark open areas.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #28
stops.whyHere: Narrow yellow and green lines trace tall shapes across a dark field. Pink, blue and pale marks fill some of the spaces between them. The thin outlines remain visible even where the broader colored patches obscure their continuity.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: White tangled lines are replaced by tall yellow outlines with colored patches between them.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #23
stops.whyHere: Thin yellow horizontals cross taller dark uprights on a muted pink-gray field. Tangled black marks gather along the bottom and corners. The long open crossings contrast with these compact areas where lines become difficult to separate.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The ground lightens, and yellow lines travel horizontally across dark uprights rather than outlining tall shapes.

chapters.title: Bars, grids and interruptions
chapters.introduction: Broad straight marks offer another kind of route. Compare an overlapping field with a large black grid, then look for places where irregular marks break those structures apart.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #21
stops.whyHere: Colored bars and translucent-looking planes overlap at many angles. Black dotted trails and white scratched-looking lines cross the same field. Repeated marks provide small routes through an arrangement whose broad divisions point in several directions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Long open crossings become overlapping colored planes with dotted trails through them.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #24
stops.whyHere: Orange, yellow and pale bars crisscross a densely colored field. Black upright marks punctuate the crossings, with bright patches visible between them. The repeated straight elements provide a framework while their uneven spacing keeps it from becoming a regular lattice.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The broad planes give way to more definite orange and pale bars, punctuated by black uprights.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #39
stops.whyHere: Black horizontal and vertical bars form a large uneven grid. Scattered dark splashes and smaller colored marks occupy its pale spaces. The grid establishes compartments, while the irregular marks refuse to stay neatly within them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The bars become a larger black grid whose pale compartments remain visible.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #0000
stops.whyHere: A broad yellow area interrupts a pale, heavily marked field. Thin black lines, clustered dark marks and purple patches remain visible on both sides of it. The horizontal division offers a place to begin looking without resolving the image into a single subject.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The regular compartments give way to a yellow division crossed by fine lines and uneven dark clusters.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #45
stops.whyHere: Long pink, yellow and pale lines cross a light ground filled with dark and colored interruptions. Vertical dark marks compete with diagonal routes. The bright surround makes individual crossings readable even where the density of marks increases.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow division opens into a pale field where long diagonal lines remain individually readable.

galleries.title: Color Held in Bands
galleries.question: When do overlapping bands become a structure?
galleries.introduction: These seventeen works compare broad color divisions with the shorter bars, blocks and rounded forms inside them. Pale grounds make some crossings easy to read; dark fields give bright fragments a different weight. The closing chapter loosens the bands and leaves separate shapes suspended in open space.
galleries.closing: Choose one boundary that looked firm and another that seemed to dissolve. How much of the structure depended on the colors on either side?

chapters.title: Pale planes and sharp crossings
chapters.introduction: Begin with broad pale divisions. Small dark bars and colored crossings remain legible inside them, providing intervals without turning the whole surface into a regular grid.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #09
stops.whyHere: Pale vertical bands descend through pink, gray and muted blue areas. Several dark horizontal lines cross near the lower middle, with a yellow upright passing through them. Their small intersection gives a point of reference within the softer surrounding divisions.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #12
stops.whyHere: Pink and pale blue planes are crossed by thin orange bars and dark vertical strips. A rough light area interrupts the upper center. Look at how the narrow crossings stay legible inside much broader, softly edged bands.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dark low crossings give way to orange horizontals inside broader pink and blue planes.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #10
stops.whyHere: Broad pale strips cross darker blue, gray and mauve fields. Small red, orange and blue blocks sit near these intersections, particularly in the lower half. Their sharper edges punctuate a surface whose larger boundaries remain blurred.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Small colored blocks punctuate the softened planes rather than extending into long bars.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #29
stops.whyHere: Tall muted bands are interrupted by short black horizontal marks near the upper and middle areas. Turquoise and orange crossings sit lower down. These small dark bars give the softer vertical divisions a sharper set of intervals.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The small blocks give way to short black bars that interrupt tall muted bands.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #31
stops.whyHere: Several red horizontal bars cross pale upright bands near the center. Fine angular lines gather around their upper edges, with purple diagonal marks below. The clear red crossings hold their shape amid smaller, more irregular interruptions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Red crossings take the place of black bars and become more continuous across the pale uprights.

chapters.title: Structure in darker fields
chapters.introduction: Turn from pale bands to dark surrounds. Yellow, turquoise and orange fragments stand apart, while bars and uprights divide the space around them without fully enclosing it.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #14
stops.whyHere: Yellow short bars interrupt a dark brown and muted red field. Pale upright shapes form an uneven central column, with smaller blue and cream patches below. The dark surround keeps these separate pieces legible without joining them into one continuous outline.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The pale ground darkens, leaving short yellow bars and a central light column easier to isolate.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #33
stops.whyHere: Yellow block-like areas sit within dark crossing bars on a muted green field. A pink vertical shape interrupts the lower center. Compare the contained yellow patches with the longer yellow diagonal that travels beyond their boundaries.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Yellow fragments enlarge into block-like patches held among dark crossings.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #26
stops.whyHere: Dark purple and red areas are punctuated by bright turquoise blocks. Several upright strips divide the center, while shorter horizontal marks connect them. The blue patches become points of orientation inside the much darker surrounding field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Turquoise patches replace the yellow blocks inside a darker red and purple arrangement.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #32
stops.whyHere: Short yellow and orange marks repeat across a dark magenta field. Pale crossing bands sit behind and between them. The repeated warm marks establish intervals, while their varied sizes and uneven alignments prevent a fixed pattern.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The isolated turquoise patches give way to repeated short orange and yellow marks across magenta.

chapters.title: Color at the boundaries
chapters.introduction: Bright patches accumulate and cross one another. Compare softened vertical divisions with pale planes and darker bars, then notice how rough edges change the continuity of a band.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #15
stops.whyHere: Turquoise vertical areas sit among yellow, red, pale pink and darker rectangular patches. Boundaries overlap and soften rather than forming a regular grid. Follow a single upright band to see where neighboring colors cover or interrupt it.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The short repeated marks broaden into overlapping turquoise, yellow and red upright areas.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #16
stops.whyHere: Pale pink and white planes surround black bars and smaller yellow, orange and purple shapes. Several horizontal crossings tie the upper and lower areas together. The broad pale divisions leave room to notice the shorter marks embedded within them.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Broader pale planes interrupt the bright uprights, leaving smaller colored marks inside them.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #17
stops.whyHere: Bright blue, orange, green and pink marks accumulate around darker vertical divisions. Pale strokes interrupt the center and lower areas. The surface is densely occupied, but the uprights still provide a way to separate neighboring patches of color.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The open pale planes fill with denser bright patches organized around dark uprights.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #20
stops.whyHere: Wide turquoise, pink and white marks cross black and yellow interruptions. Many edges are broken rather than smoothly bounded. The image offers bands of color, but their rough divisions keep the bands from becoming a settled pattern.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The upright organization loosens into wide turquoise and pale bands with visibly broken edges.

chapters.title: Shapes with room around them
chapters.introduction: The final works let separate shapes remain visible. Compare a loose built arrangement, two kinds of white interruption, rounded forms, and colored blocks separated by a pale ground.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #11
stops.whyHere: Orange horizontal marks gather above pale green and yellow areas. Upright and descending lines connect several levels, while dark patches interrupt the lower corners. The image can suggest a built arrangement without settling into a specific building or place.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Broken bright bands become a looser arrangement of orange crossings and pale green areas.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #13
stops.whyHere: A yellow field occupies the upper middle of green, pink and orange divisions. Broad white crossing marks gather lower down, accompanied by thin repeated lines. The two light areas provide different kinds of interruption: one nearly filled, the other visibly broken.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The green areas become a stronger yellow field, with broken white crossings below it.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #30
stops.whyHere: A large pink-red rounded shape sits low in a pale field crossed by blue horizontal bands. A smaller outlined circle appears above and to the right. Their different sizes and positions make a contrast within the surrounding rectangular divisions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The white crossings give way to blue bands passing through a large pink-red rounded shape.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #49
stops.whyHere: A pink rectangular area and a green block sit apart on a pale ground. Smaller yellow and red-green shapes occupy the upper area, connected by fine crossing lines. The open spacing makes each colored shape legible before the connecting marks become apparent.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The broad bands separate into isolated pink and green blocks with fine lines between them.

galleries.title: Surfaces Opening and Closing
galleries.question: How much open ground does a cluster of marks need?
galleries.introduction: These seventeen works move between surfaces covered in small marks, broad rounded arrangements and formations surrounded by light ground. Compare the edge of a cluster with its interior. A pale surround may separate the marks clearly, while a densely occupied field makes that separation harder to maintain.
galleries.closing: Return to a dense surface and an open one. Where did you notice individual marks first, and where did you begin with the edge of the whole formation?

chapters.title: Across the whole surface
chapters.introduction: Color and texture occupy almost every area. Follow a band, then compare the uneven gaps left by dark patches and pale tangled marks across neighboring colored fields.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #02
stops.whyHere: Small colored marks cover nearly the whole surface, gathering into loose horizontal zones. Yellow and green areas remain connected through scattered pink and darker flecks. The eye can follow a band across the image, then lose it among the smaller interruptions.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #07
stops.whyHere: Broken black textures spread over muted purple, yellow and turquoise areas. Pale thin lines cross the darker patches without following their edges. The dark marks divide the surface unevenly, leaving openings through which the underlying color remains visible.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The small colored marks gather into larger dark textures separated by openings of purple and yellow.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #06
stops.whyHere: Irregular dark vertical zones separate thick-looking patches of green, pink, blue and yellow. Fine tangled lines lie across several patches. These two scales of marking make the surface readable both as broad colored divisions and as a much smaller network of crossings.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Broken black textures become more definite vertical zones among brighter, thicker-looking patches.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #27
stops.whyHere: Rough-edged patches of pink, green, orange and blue meet across a textured surface. Pale tangled marks cover parts of their boundaries. Rather than offering one clear direction, the image invites looking at how each patch passes into the next.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The vertical divisions loosen into rough-edged patches that pass into one another.

chapters.title: Rounded boundaries
chapters.introduction: Rounded forms establish larger boundaries within a busy surface. Compare separate dark shapes with curved bands, broken arcs and an arched formation whose marks descend below it.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #44
stops.whyHere: Several dark rounded forms sit within a yellow-green field. Smaller circular and irregular marks surround them. Their broad boundaries make them distinct from the rough surface, though the edges blur where neighboring colors meet.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The scattered patches gather into several dark rounded forms within a yellow-green surround.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #37
stops.whyHere: Broad curved bands turn around a bright lower-center opening. Black and white broken edges interrupt blue, red, yellow and purple areas. The repeated arcs suggest rotation, while the ragged marks keep the turns from forming a smooth spiral.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Separate rounded forms give way to larger turning bands around one lower-center opening.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #46
stops.whyHere: Broken black and yellow arcs surround a loosely defined pale center. Shorter gray and blue marks sit between the arcs. Their repeated curvature creates a circular arrangement while leaving gaps through which the surrounding neutral ground enters.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The densely colored turning bands open into broken black and yellow arcs on neutral ground.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #pos
stops.whyHere: An arched concentration of red, orange and darker marks occupies a gray field. Long black and turquoise lines descend from its lower edge. The rounded upper boundary and the hanging lines provide two different directions within the same formation.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The broken circle becomes an arched upper boundary with long lines hanging below it.

chapters.title: Ground left visible
chapters.introduction: Light or muted surrounds make smaller marks easier to isolate. Compare scattered interruptions, a single fine route, an enclosing contour and a central formation with an uneven edge.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #35
stops.whyHere: A pale gray surface carries scattered black, yellow and pink interruptions. Curved chains of small light marks pass through the lower half. The open ground lets these broken routes remain visible without enclosing them in a strong outer shape.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The crowded arch opens into a pale field with scattered marks and curved light chains.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #48
stops.whyHere: Pale pink, turquoise and mauve marks spread across a light gray field. A thin dark looping line passes through the lower middle and up the right side. That line supplies a distinct route through an otherwise softly divided surface.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The scattered interruptions soften into pale color, while one dark line provides a continuous route.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #38
stops.whyHere: Thin black contours surround lightly colored patches on a pale ground. Smaller loops collect near the lower center. The placement can suggest a face, but the broad enclosing outline and loose interior shapes also remain readable as separate marks.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The fine route becomes an enclosing contour around loosely placed interior shapes.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #40
stops.whyHere: A loose central formation occupies a gray ground, with pale brown marks above and dark blue-gray strokes below. Bright red accents concentrate near its lower edge. The surrounding open space makes the uneven outline more prominent than the internal divisions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The thin enclosure gives way to a more substantial central formation surrounded by gray.

chapters.title: Gathering at the center
chapters.introduction: Long strokes, crossing bands and irregular patches gather into central areas. Compare how each concentration meets its surround, ending where a wide pale field makes dark edges clear.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #41
stops.whyHere: Long pale, blue and purple strokes rise through a light field. Yellow accents punctuate the lower and middle areas. The repeated uprights create a broad central concentration, though their uneven lengths leave its edge open.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The compact central formation extends into long pale and blue uprights with an open upper edge.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #42
stops.whyHere: Dark diagonal bands cross at the center of a magenta field. Pale and yellow strokes travel through the same intersection. The crossing establishes a clear focal area, while scattered surrounding marks keep that area from becoming a closed shape.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The uprights give way to diagonal bands that concentrate attention at one central crossing.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #43
stops.whyHere: Black, white and yellow irregular marks accumulate over blue, green and muted red areas. Thin lines weave between the larger patches. The pale interruptions break up the dense center and make several small openings visible within it.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The central crossing breaks into irregular black, white and yellow patches with small openings between them.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #47
stops.whyHere: Broad black, turquoise, yellow and magenta strokes gather in a central formation on a pale blue-gray ground. Pink loops cross the lower center. The loose outer edges let parts of the formation extend into the surrounding space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The scattered patches gather into broader central strokes crossed by pink loops.

stops.title: nnxyz abstract #50
stops.whyHere: Dark uprights and bright blue, pink and orange fragments gather within a yellow and white surround. Pale broken strokes cut across the central concentration. The wide light areas make the irregular dark edges especially easy to follow.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The broad colored strokes narrow into darker uprights within a larger yellow and white surround.
